QuestInfo.name: Kyrin and Athena Pierce
QuestInfo.0: Kyrin wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: Meet Athena Pierce in Henesys. Henesys is left of the Six Path Crossway. Athena Pierce is at the Bowman Instructional School.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Athena Pierce the Bowman Instructor as Kyrin has requested.

0.0: Oh, hey! It's #h0#. How have you been doing? You know, I heard that my old friend Athena Pierce wanted to talk to you...
0.1: Go to Henesys and meet Athena Pierce. She should be at the Bowman Instructional School.\r\n(Accept to be moved to the Bowman Instructional School.)
0.2: She specifically asked to speak to you. She's waiting for you in Henesys.

yes.1: Henesys is left of the Six Path Crossway. Athena Pierce will be waiting for you at the Bowman Instructional School.

no.0: I don't care how busy you are, you're going.

1.0: Hello, #h0#. How have you been doing?

npc.0: Talking to #bAthena Pierce#k is a privilege. You could learn much from her. All Explorers could.
